svg.desc: 10 Underground Dams in Jazan LOCATION Jazan, KSA CLIENT Ministry of Water and Electricity COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2011 N/A DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This 10 Dams project for the Ministry of Water and Electricity in the Jazan region of KSA aimed to enhance underground water utilization and aquifer storage in a semi-arid environment prone to drought. BECT's scope included detailed drawings, tender documents and site supervision. The multidisciplinary services covered urban planning & design, architectural design, structural / civil engineering, mechanical engineering and electrical engineering.
